## Initialization

```{r init_}
#| output: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Import libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(ggfortify)
library(patchwork)

# Source color palette.
source("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0012/fcgl_sci/theme_color_palette.R")
source("/omics/odcf/analysis/OE0538_projects/DO-0012/fcgl_sci/misc_functions.R")

# Set seed.
base::set.seed(708813)

# Initialize lists to store the plots and statistical tests.
plots <- list()
tests <- list()
```

## Import data.

```{r import_lipidomics}
#| output: false
#| warning: false
metadata <- readxl::read_xlsx("/omics/groups/OE0538/internal/projects/liver_fcg/tables/Suppl_Table_1_OverviewData.xlsx", sheet = "Sample overview", trim_ws = TRUE)
data_lipids <- readxl::read_xlsx("/omics/groups/OE0538/internal/projects/liver_fcg/tables/Suppl_Table_1_OverviewData.xlsx", sheet = "Lipidomics", trim_ws = TRUE)

# Transform data into long format.
data_lipids <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::select(Lipid, Class, Category, Adduct_type, Ion_mode, starts_with("sx42_")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("sx42_"), names_to = "sample", values_to = "intensity") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(intensity = as.numeric(intensity))

# Add metadata.
data_lipids <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::inner_join(metadata, by = c("sample" = "sequencing_name")) %>% 
    dplyr::select(Lipid, Class, Category, Adduct_type, Ion_mode, sample, group, allosome_type, gonadal_type, intensity)

# Select only FCG samples.
data_FCG <- data_lipids %>% dplyr::filter(group != "XYT-WT")
```

## Visualize overall variance between FCG groups.

```{r plot_pca}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-pca
#| fig-cap: "Principal component analysis of the lipidomics data."
#| cap-location: margin
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-dpi: 720
# Determine variable lipids.
data_lipids <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
        mean = mean(intensity),
        sd = sd(intensity),
        cv = sd / mean,
        'CV ≥ 0.5' = dplyr::if_else(cv >= 0.5, "Yes", "No")
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup()

var_lipids <- data_lipids %>% dplyr::distinct(Lipid, cv) %>% dplyr::filter(cv >= 0.5) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)

plots$variance <- data_lipids %>% dplyr::distinct(Lipid, mean, cv, `CV ≥ 0.5`) %>% 
    ggplot2::ggplot(., ggplot2::aes(x = mean, y = cv, fill = `CV ≥ 0.5`)) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::log10_trans()) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = .5, lty = "11", lwd = .5, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "grey80")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Mean intensity (log<sub>10</sub>)", y = "CV", caption = sprintf("%s variable lipids.", length(var_lipids))) +
    scir::theme_ggplot()

# Perform PCA on variable lipids.
data_pca <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::filter(`CV ≥ 0.5` == "Yes") %>% 
    dplyr::distinct(sample, Lipid, intensity) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Lipid, values_from = intensity) %>% 
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    stats::prcomp(center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Plot scree.
plots$scree <- data_pca %>% 
    broom::tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") %>% 
    dplyr::filter(PC <= 20) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(PC = paste0("PC", PC)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = reorder(PC, -percent), y = percent)) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey80", color = "black", lwd = .2, size = .8) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, .3), labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Principal components", y = "Var. explained") +
    scir::theme_ggplot() +
    ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = .5, size = 6), 
        panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )

# Plot PCA.
plots$pca <- data_pca %>% 
    broom::augment(data_lipids %>% dplyr::distinct(sample, group, gonadal_type, allosome_type)) %>% 
    ggplot2::ggplot(., aes(x = .fittedPC1, y = .fittedPC2, color = group, fill = group, label = gonadal_type)) + 
    ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(expand = unit(1, "mm"), alpha = .05, color = "black", mapping = aes(fill = gonadal_type)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", size = 2.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-25, 25)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-25, 25)) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
    ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Group", nrow = 1, title.position = "top", title.hjust = .5)) +
    scir::theme_ggplot()

design = "
ABB
ACC"
plots$variance + plots$scree + plots$pca + patchwork::plot_layout(design = design, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 4))
```

## Statistics.

### Normality test.

Prior to any statistical testing, we will check if the data is normally distributed to determine which statistical test to use.

```{r determine_normality}
#| message: false
#| label: tbl-normality
#| tbl-cap: Shapiro-Wilk; log2 lipid measurements
# For each lipid, check if it follows a normal distribution.
# Shapiro-Wilk test; null hypothesis is that the data is normally distributed.
# Therefore, p < 0.05 indicates non-normal distribution.
tests$normality <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
        shapiro_test = shapiro.test(log2(intensity))$p.value,
        distribution = ifelse(shapiro_test < 0.05, "Non-normal distribution", "Normal distribution")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

knitr::kable(table(tests$normality$distribution)) %>% 
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = TRUE)
```

```{r show_density}
#| label: fig-density
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the log2 measurements of 10 random lipids."
#| cap-location: margin
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-dpi: 720
# Generate density plot of three random lipids.
plots$density <- data_lipids %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Lipid %in% sample(data_lipids$Lipid, 12)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = log2(intensity), fill = group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_density(alpha = .5) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "log2(intensity)", y = "Density") +
    scir::theme_ggplot() +
    facet_wrap(~Lipid, ncol = 4, scales = "free")

plots$density
```


### Sanity check - XYT-WT vs. XYT

```{r statistics_lipidomics_XYT}
# Pairwise Wilcoxon test to determine significant differences between XYT and XYT-WT.
data_WT <- data_lipids %>% dplyr::filter(group %in% c("XYT", "XYT-WT"))

tests$XYTvsWT <- data_WT %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid, Class, Category, Adduct_type, Ion_mode) %>%
    rstatix::wilcox_test(intensity ~ group, paired = FALSE, ref.group = "XYT", detailed = TRUE, exact = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided", p.adjust.method = "none") %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH")

# Add the log2 fold change and effect-size.
tests$XYTvsWT <- data_WT %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid) %>% 
    dplyr::summarise(
        log2FoldChange = mean(log2(intensity[group == "XYT"])) - mean(log2(intensity[group != "XYT"]))
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::inner_join(tests$XYTvsWT, by = "Lipid") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
        Significance = dplyr::case_when(
            p.adj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >= 0 ~ "XYT",
            p.adj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -0 ~ "XYT-WT",
            TRUE ~ "n.s."
        ),
        q = -log10(p.adj)
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sig-WT
#| tbl-cap: (XYT vs. XYT-WT) No. of sig. lipids.
knitr::kable(table("Significance" = tests$XYTvsWT$Significance)) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r plot_XYT}
#| message: false
#| label: fig-XYT
#| fig-cap: "Overview of the significant differences between XYT and XYT-WT."
#| cap-location: margin
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-dpi: 720

# Perform Fisher"s exact test to determine if the significant differences are enriched in certain lipid categories.
tests$XYTvsWT.CatClass <- tests$XYTvsWT %>% dplyr::mutate(group = sprintf("(%s) %s", Category, Class)) %>% test_Fisher()
tests$XYTvsWT.Cat <- tests$XYTvsWT %>% dplyr::mutate(group = Category) %>% test_Fisher()

# Generate the plots.
plots$XYTvsWT.volcano <- generate_volcanoplot_lipid(tests$XYTvsWT)

# Between categories.
plots$XYTvsWT.Cat <- generate_lipid_grouped_barplot(tests$XYTvsWT %>% dplyr::mutate(group = Category), tests$XYTvsWT.Cat, "XYT", nudge = 5,  ytitle = "Lipid categories")
plots$XYTvsWT.CatFC <- generate_lipid_grouped_barplot_FC(
    data_lipids %>% dplyr::filter(group %in% c("XYT", "XYT-WT")) %>%  dplyr::mutate(groupFC = group, group = Category),
    tests$XYTvsWT.Cat, "XYT"
)

# Between categories + classes.
plots$XYTvsWT.CatClass <- generate_lipid_grouped_barplot(tests$XYTvsWT %>% dplyr::mutate(group = sprintf("(%s) %s", Category, Class)), tests$XYTvsWT.CatClass, "XYT", nudge = 5, "Lipid classes")
plots$XYTvsWT.CatClassFC <- generate_lipid_grouped_barplot_FC(
    data_lipids %>% dplyr::filter(group %in% c("XYT", "XYT-WT")) %>%  dplyr::mutate(groupFC = group, group = sprintf("(%s) %s", Category, Class)),
    tests$XYTvsWT.CatClass, "XYT"
)

design = "ABC
ADE
"
plots$XYTvsWT.volcano + plots$XYTvsWT.Cat + plots$XYTvsWT.CatFC + plots$XYTvsWT.CatClass + plots$XYTvsWT.CatClassFC + 
    patchwork::plot_layout(design = design, widths = c(1.25, .75, .4), heights = c(.45, 1), guides = "collect")
```

### Test for significant difference between FCG groups

Using the Kruskal-Wallis one-way ANOVA with post-hoc Dunn tests, we will determine statistically-significant differences between FCG groups (excl. XYT-WT).

```{r statistics_lipidomics_FCG}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-fcg
#| tbl-cap: "Significant differences between FCG groups."
# Perform Kruskal-Wallis test across FCG types
tests$FCG.Anova <- data_FCG %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid, Class, Category, Adduct_type, Ion_mode) %>%
    rstatix::kruskal_test(intensity ~ group) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH")

# Determine post-hoc significance between group using Dunn’s test for the significant lipids.
tests$FCG.Dunn <- data_FCG %>%
    dplyr::filter(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Anova %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid))) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(Lipid, Class, Category, Adduct_type, Ion_mode) %>%
    rstatix::dunn_test(intensity ~ group) %>% 
    dplyr::ungroup() %>% 
    rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
        q = -log10(p.adj)
    )
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sig-FCG
#| tbl-cap: (FCG) No. of sig. lipids.
knitr::kable(
    x = table(tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::select(group1, group2))
) %>% 
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r heatmap_lipids}
#| label: fig-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Heatmap of the significant differences between FCG groups."
#| cap-location: margin
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-dpi: 720
# Retrieve the lipid measurements.
data_heat <- data_FCG %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
        `(Gonad) Testes vs. Ovaries` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$TvsO %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
        `(Allosome) XY vs. XX` = 0,
        `(Allosome) XXO vs. XYO` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05 & group1 %in% c("XXO", "XYO") & group2 %in% c("XXO", "XYO")) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
        `(Allosome) XYT vs. XXT` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05 & group1 %in% c("XYT", "XXT") & group2 %in% c("XYT", "XXT")) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
        `(Gonad) XXO vs. XXT` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05 & group1 %in% c("XXO", "XXT") & group2 %in% c("XXO", "XXT")) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
        `(Gonad) XYT vs. XYO` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05 & group1 %in% c("XYT", "XYO") & group2 %in% c("XYT", "XYO")) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
        `(Allosome) XY vs. XX` = dplyr::if_else(Lipid %in% (tests$XYvsXX %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)), 1, 0),
    ) %>% 
    # Select only significant lipids.
    dplyr::filter(Lipid %in% (tests$FCG.Dunn %>% dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>% dplyr::pull(Lipid)) | `(Gonad) Testes vs. Ovaries` == 1) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        `Gonad` = gonadal_type,
        `Allosome` = allosome_type
    )

# Plot heatmap.
tidyheatmaps::tidyheatmap(
    df = data_heat,
    row = sample,
    column = Lipid,
    value = intensity,
    scale = "column", 
    show_rownames = FALSE, 
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE, cellheight = 3, cellwidth = .5,
    show_colnames = FALSE, 
    clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean", 
    clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean", 
    clustering_method = "ward.D2", 
    treeheight_col = 20, treeheight_row = 20,
    colors = grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2", "white", "#A51122"))(100), color_legend_n = 100,
    annotation_row = c(Allosome, Gonad), 
    annotation_col = c(`(Allosome) XXO vs. XYO`, `(Allosome) XYT vs. XXT`, `(Gonad) XXO vs. XXT`, `(Gonad) XYT vs. XYO`, `(Allosome) XY vs. XX`, `(Gonad) Testes vs. Ovaries`),
)
```

### Visualize significant lipid classes per FCG group.

```{r plot_lipid_classes}
#| label: fig-lipid_classes_FCG
#| fig-cap: "Significant lipid classes per FCG group."
#| cap-location: margin
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-dpi: 720
data_classes <- tests$FCG.Dunn %>% 
    dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Category, group1, group2) %>%
    dplyr::count() %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() 

data_classes %>% 
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = group1, y = Category, size = n, fill = Category)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = .4) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = n), size = 4, color = "black") +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(~group2, scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Comparison", y = "Lipid classes") +
    ggplot2::guides(
        fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "Lipid classes", nrow = 3, title.position = "top", title.hjust = .5),
        size = ggplot2::guide_legend(title = "No. lipids", nrow = 3, title.position = "top", title.hjust = .5)
    ) +
    scir::theme_ggplot()
```
